purpose: Teach: くっつけ/談笑/オット/奥底/仇/ぶさ/里帰り/見いだす

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、ノートにシール沢山くっつけ過ぎだぞ
lines.en: Riku, you're putting way too many stickers all over your notebook.
lines.style: Dry, teasing observation. Light, sideways delivery. Shoulder shrug in the voice. Not mean — just calling out what she sees.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、放課後、友達と談笑してたな、桜
lines.en: You were laughing with your friends after school the other day, weren't you, Sakura?
lines.style: Gentle turnabout. Quiet satisfaction underneath. Leans in slightly — noticing her the way she notices him. No accusation, just acknowledgment.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前のお姉ちゃん、オットができたって聞いたぞ
lines.en: I heard your sister got married, Riku.
lines.style: Curious, conversational. Testing the waters to see how he'll react. Light touch — not prying, just... interested in what matters to him.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、心の奥底に秘密があるみたいだな、桜
lines.en: Sounds like you've got something you're keeping locked away, Sakura.
lines.style: Slow, thoughtful. Like he's figured something out and is handing it to her gently. Steady eye-contact level in the voice. Not accusatory — just seeing her.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、ライバルを仇のように見るな
lines.en: Don't treat your rivals like they're your enemy, Riku.
lines.style: Straightforward, direct. A small note of concern underneath. She's not scolding — she's warning him about something she's noticed. Holds the line steady.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、自分の写真を「ぶさ過ぎ」と笑ってたな、桜
lines.en: You were laughing at your own photo, calling yourself ugly the other day.
lines.style: Wry mirror-back. Matching his tone from earlier — catching him in the same way he caught her. Light and sharp, not unkind.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、夏休みに里帰りしてたな
lines.en: You went back home to visit family over summer break, didn't you?
lines.style: Casual curiosity. Conversational, almost offhand. The kind of observation that says she notices his patterns, his rhythms. Gentle interest.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、自分の才能を見いだす人に出会えると良いな、桜
lines.en: I hope you find someone who can see the talent in you, Sakura.
lines.style: Soft, genuine close. Reaches across the distance between them. Vulnerable underneath — what he actually means. Warm steady pace. Trailing slight fade into sincerity.
